title: Tiger edit (beat-synced)

scenes.label: Top weight of an Amur tiger

caption:
Built for power, happy in water.

The Siberian (Amur) tiger is the largest tiger, up to about 4 m long including the tail. Opening shot: a WWF release in the Russian Far East.

Source: Britannica; WWF footage on Wikimedia Commons.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Fan-edit demo with a split-screen beat and a stat payoff; mixes wild release footage with captive clips (no wild claims made). Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
